title: Individual-to-Unit Effects, Casualties, Damage & Recovery
objective: Implement a visibility-first deterministic read-only reconciliation projection that maps explicit canonical individual/member casualty, damage and recovery results into SCL unit/profile effect summaries and handoffs without duplicating or mutating owner-domain state.

source_rules: Squad & Fleet.PDF collective squad HP and repair language
Non-lethal Damage 11-13-24.PDF lethal/non-lethal zero-HP stability and death-threshold language
rules: Visibility filters before member/effect inclusion, counts, totals, classifications, summaries, search, provenance, handoffs, deterministic receipts or AI context; hidden existence/cardinality is undisclosed.
SCL-09 accepts explicit canonical owner-result/state references and may derive only read-only deterministic unit rollups from visible compatible evidence.

The retained squad collective-HP rule is source evidence and may be represented only when explicit compatible visible member HP inputs and the selected source rule are supplied; it does not replace owner HP truth or create a universal SCL HP ledger.

Non-lethal/lethal zero-HP, massive-damage, injury, healing, repair, destruction and recovery rules remain source/owner-domain mechanics; SCL-09 may reference/classify their explicit results but does not execute them.

No damage or recovery propagates automatically between vehicle, crew, passenger, nested Asset, squad, fleet or other constituents. Cross-entity effects require explicit canonical owner-result references.
Missing/hidden/unknown/conflict/incompatible evidence remains unresolved and is never guessed or reconciled by AI.
Stable IDs/orderings and deterministic receipts are required; duplicate visible canonical constituent/effect identity makes completeness false rather than being silently merged.

minimum_cross_domain_authority: retained source PDFs: Squad & Fleet; Healing 11-7-24; Resist,immune,damage; Non-lethal Damage 11-13-24
current Permission/visibility and Combat/Action/Event owner boundaries
invalidation_events: required validation reports a materially new failure signature

validation_requirement: Exactly one SCL-09 current-family profile, zero historical predecessor fanout, genuine matching self-hosted Linux/Windows acceptance RED before production mutation, then exact-head Linux/Windows GREEN and deterministic comparison.
